name: design-craft
description: Design or review a user-facing visual artifact — a landing page, app screen, dashboard, clickable prototype, native mobile mockup, wireframe, variation set, tweakable panel, motion piece, 3D hero, print document, generated imagery or design system — as an opinionated designer rather than a code generator. Roots every hi-fi build in existing context by default and lifts a matched system's resolved values exactly, never rounding them to a 4/8px grid and reporting the rounding as a fix. Names the category's rut and its predictable opposite before generating, derives seven candidates across at least three material families as a probability distribution rather than a best answer, and writes the chosen direction into the artifact as a five-block contract the critique gate then audits promise by promise — because more than a quarter of a generative UI tool's stated design rationales are measured not to appear in what it built. Ships a deterministic gate that computes WCAG contrast from source across hex, rgba, hsl and oklch, follows tokens to their :root definitions, composites opacity, and treats contrast as tri-state: a gradient, image or undeclared ground is reported UNMEASURABLE rather than skipped, since an unmeasured pair and a passing pair otherwise serialise identically. The gate names the silent downstream consequence of every finding, gates on mechanism and warns on fashion, runs markup checks through a real HTML parser, refuses to lint its own documentation, requires a reason on every suppression, proves each of its forty rules can still fire, and prints what it did not check so a clean run cannot be read as verified. Carries a Known limits section measured against the one sanctioned browser, so motion, print, reduced-motion and type fidelity are declared unchecked rather than reported clean — and names the delivery surface's own refusals, because a CDN script inside a published artifact is blocked with no error and the page ships motionless. Thirty phased procedures, per-unit critique gates with a computed disposition, an autonomous mode, and a standing pairing with ux-craft for flows, forms and UX review.
